description: This file defines core components for a SwiftUI application's state management, including generic reducers, a store class with Combine integration, and some utility methods. It appears to be a central part of the application's model layer.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: An observable object managing application state with the ability to dispatch actions and handle effects using Combine.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Dispatches an action, runs the reducer, and manages the resulting effect's lifecycle.

methods.name: derived
methods.description: Creates a derived store focused on a subset of the state and actions.
